title: Sip & Sketch in the Sculpture Park at Pt. Leo Estate
summary: Winter school holiday family experience: kids get a hot chocolate and cookie while adults enjoy wine. All-day Sculpture Park access included. Booking required.
suitableFor: Families with children; couples with young kids; art-interested families
accessibilityNotes: Sculpture park has accessible paths; contact venue for specific requirements
weatherDependency: Outdoor sculpture park — dress for winter; on-site shelter available
nearbyAttractions: Balnarring Village; Merricks General Store; Stonier Wines
suggestedItineraryPairing: Sip & Sketch in the morning, lunch at Pt. Leo Estate restaurant or Merricks General Store, afternoon at Stonier or Paringa
editorVerdict: Smarter than a standard school holiday outing and genuinely enjoyable for adults at the same time. The Sculpture Park in winter has its own atmosphere.
editorNote:
Pt. Leo Estate's school holiday programme packages a Sip & Sketch experience through the Sculpture Park. Adults get wine, kids get hot chocolate and a cookie, and the sketching gives them something to do with the sculptures rather than just walking past them.

All-day park access is included. The family pass is the right call for two adults and two kids. Book online — the school holiday period at Pt. Leo fills up.

Pairs well with a Merricks General Store lunch before or after, or a stop at Stonier on the way out.
